Ported native git invocations across the tool suite from the PowerShell & call operator to Diagnostics.Process (stderr captured via .NET), since Set-StrictMode/ErrorActionPreference=Stop can promote a harmless git stderr warning (e.g. core.autocrlf CRLF notices) into a terminating error that survives even a local 2>$null redirect in some hosts; also fixed two BOM-less non-ASCII source files that parsed differently under Windows PowerShell 5.1's default (non-UTF8) script-loading encoding, a String.Contains(string, StringComparison) call that is .NET 5+ only, and an over-eager session-reconciliation heuristic that could reap a still-in-use session. Documented workflow/index-pipeline/task-lifecycle behavior and output shapes are unchanged; this is exclusively a portability and process-invocation-safety change.

Fixed the same class of bug across ~18 files: $x = if (cond) {...} else { @() } assigns $null instead of an empty array when the else branch runs, because PowerShell does not preserve 'zero output objects' as a value across an if/else used as an expression (proven: $null -eq (if ($false) { 1 } else { @() }) is True). Confirmed via Manage-LlmWikiInstructionOutcome.ps1 crashing wiki.ps1 instruction-outcome-metrics on first real (non-empty) registry data. Wrapped each affected assignment in an outer @(...) so the else branch reliably yields an empty array instead of null. Documented output shapes and behavior for non-empty branches are unchanged.

Ported native git invocations across the tool suite from the PowerShell & call operator to Diagnostics.Process (stderr captured via .NET), since Set-StrictMode/ErrorActionPreference=Stop can promote a harmless git stderr warning (e.g. core.autocrlf CRLF notices) into a terminating error that survives even a local 2>$null redirect in some hosts; also fixed two BOM-less non-ASCII source files that parsed differently under Windows PowerShell 5.1's default (non-UTF8) script-loading encoding, a String.Contains(string, StringComparison) call that is .NET 5+ only, and an over-eager session-reconciliation heuristic that could reap a still-in-use session. Documented workflow/index-pipeline/task-lifecycle behavior and output shapes are unchanged; this is exclusively a portability and process-invocation-safety change.
Traced MailInbox behavior from SMTP admission through storage, HTTP DTOs, typed client, core integration mapping, OpenAPI, and the admin UI; all changed consumers and trust boundaries are covered.

Fixed the same class of bug across ~18 files: $x = if (cond) {...} else { @() } assigns $null instead of an empty array when the else branch runs, because PowerShell does not preserve 'zero output objects' as a value across an if/else used as an expression (proven: $null -eq (if ($false) { 1 } else { @() }) is True).
